prototypeScope: V1.11 Orange increment on top of the printed V1.9 set: the rear converter box, layout F (guide/print/back-plate/layout-F/), printed as the frame and a lid. The frame replaces the printed V1.8 rear pack cover and supersedes the V1.10 frame and lid (layout C revision 2), which should not be printed. It carries two XL4015 step-down boards (7 V top tier, 5 V middle tier) and one Adafruit 5991 USB-C PD trigger (bottom tier). Every other printed part stays; the printed V1.8 pack stays as built.
knownFitBoundary: Frame to pack: the four V1.8 cover screws (M2 x 6) at (-47, +-16.1, 26.0) and (-47, +-16.1, -36.5); the frame goes on empty. Boards: 8 x M2 x 6 into the XL4015 bosses, 4 x M2 x 6 into the 5991 standoff bosses, cap: two tongues under the top wall with teeth in the top-wall slots (slide on 1.2 mm low, lift) and 2 x M2 x 6 through the ears at (y -23.8, z -17.4) and (y +23.8, z -33.6); the lower cover screws sit in dia 4.4 driver lanes. HOME: frame to shells 1.04 / 1.175 mm, to the OpenRB 4.931 mm. Hip sweep (each hip pitch HOME +-30 deg with hip roll +-10 deg, layout-F/hip_sweep.json): USB-C plug envelope to the left upper leg 4.28 mm minimum, frame to the legs at least 6 mm, cap at least 6 mm, window loops at least 13.9 mm. XL4015 IN ends face -y and OUT ends +y (kit photo and mesh); read the printed IN/OUT labels before wiring. The tether hole in the V1.8 pack stays open and unused. Boss tips print on support: clean them flat.
processOverrideReason: Supports: no support override. The Orange donor profiles (12-REPAIR-V1-20261008/dual-printer/Orange_*_editable.3mf) already set enable_support 1, support_type tree(auto), support_threshold_angle 30, bridge_no_support 0 and support_on_build_plate_only 0, so the frame's front plate (a ceiling 12.1 mm above the bed inside the rim-down box) and the cover flap below the box floor get tree support, and the cap (outer face down) gets tree support under its rounded rear edges and screw ears; the native slices confirm it (review/Orange_*-review.json supportByRegion). The boss tips (PCB seats) sit under the ceiling and print on support: clean them flat before mounting the boards. Brim: rear_frame stands 21.6 mm tall on a 1.2 mm wall ring (296.8 mm2) spread over a 64.1 x 87.0 mm footprint, tip angle 71.5 degrees; the cap lies on its outer face (85.4 degrees) (orientation-check.json). Neither needs a brim (guide/print/orientation-study/PRINT-ORIENTATION-PRACTICE.md R1: a brim only below a 10 degree tip angle), so brim_type is no_brim on both machines; it is set explicitly because the donor profiles default to auto_brim. The plate-wide 4 mm outer brim carried since V1.9 (head cap, 7.7 degrees) is dropped: a 0.1 mm-gap brim on the frame's 1.2 mm wall ring is very hard to peel.

parts.changeReason: V1.11 rear converter box, layout F (back-plate/layout-F/README.md): replaces the V1.10 layout C revision 2 frame and the printed V1.8 rear pack cover. The frame carries the exact cover outline, four cover holes and lip (x -47..-45) and a stepped box behind the pack with a square rim at x -59.1 and a constant cross-section, so the boards slide straight in from the rear: a wide tier |y| <= 32.05, z -15.2..43 with the two XL4015s horizontal (IN ends -y, OUT ends +y, as the kit photo and mesh show) and a narrow tier |y| <= 15.61, z -36.02..-15.2 with the Adafruit 5991 (terminal -y, USB-C +y). Closed bottom, side windows at each terminal, a USB-C slot in the +y wall, front passage P1 into the pack channel, eight XL4015 bosses (5.0 / 4.2 / 3.2 mm long, shell limited), four 5991 bosses on 3.0 mm standoffs, two cap screw bosses at (y -23.8, z -17.4) and (y +23.8, z -33.6), two tooth slots in the top wall and driver lanes for the two lower cover screws. Volume 10502.4 mm3, watertight, one body (layout-F/checks.json).
